item: A vLLM server the app starts listens where the client talks, and an address it could not serve starts nothing
summary: start() gave server_argv no host or port, so vLLM listened on the fixed 127.0.0.1 and default port whatever OO_VLLM_URL said, and base_url() froze the port at import. Now the bind and the status probe share one listen rule; a start reads the address once; another computer, 0.0.0.0, [::], an alias name, port 0, a scoped or broken IPv6 address and https start nothing and never clear the GPU, each with a sentence. The raw probe goes through connect_ex_loopback at the server's host and port. Two security reads and an Opus read; red before the fixes (7 tests).
